thread:
nijay: Heads up — SCIM jobs to Okta have been failing with 401s for the last hour. New user creates are 401 from idp token exchange. Anyone digging in?

karen: I saw spikes in errors from the provisioner. Can you paste an error line?

nijay: ```ERROR scim/provisioner: exchange_token failed org=orbital err=401 cause=invalid_client secret_decrypt_error detail="KMS Decrypt: AccessDenied" trace=...```

liam: Interesting — provisioner fetches the Okta client_secret from secrets-manager wrapped with a KMS key. If KMS decrypt fails we get bad creds and idp returns 401. Was there a key rotation or IAM change?

nijay: There was a small RBAC tidy-up last night that renamed a few IAM roles and a terraform apply touched secret attachments. The deploy-bot shows a change at 2026-03-20T02:05:00Z: aws_kms_grant.provisioner -> replaced.

deploy-bot: apply 2026-03-20T02:05:00Z by liam: resources changed: aws_kms_key.rotate=true, aws_kms_grant.provisioner recreated.

karen: KMS audit lines show Decrypt attempts returning AccessDenied and then NotFound for the wrapped key: `kms.audit time=2026-03-20T02:06:12Z action=Decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-key used_by=svc:provisioner result=AccessDenied` then later `KeyNotFound`.

liam: That fits a race where the grant was removed and re-created with the old principal. However we also changed a k8s->IAM mapping for the provisioner service account (name change) in the same deploy. Grant likely bound to the old assumed-role name.

nijay: Mitigation: 1) Pause SCIM writes for affected orgs (orbital, nova, apex) to stop noisy errors, 2) add emergency grant for the current provisioner principal, 3) rotate the stored secret (unwrap and re-wrap) if needed, 4) replay backlog once tokens are valid. Who can take 1/2?

karen: I'll pause the queues for orbital and nova now.

oncall-bot: queues paused for orbital,nova,apex by karen at 2026-03-20T02:20:11Z

liam: I'll create an emergency grant for the principal arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/provisioner-app and run a decrypt probe against one sample secret.

sec-bot: create-grant requested by liam at 2026-03-20T02:25:03Z -> grant-id=g-9c8b7a applied to key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/new-key-arn

liam: decrypt-probe `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROV" https://provisioner.internal/ops/decrypt-secret?id=okta-client-orbital` returned 200 and secret plain text. Exchanging token now... returned 200 from okta. Good.

nijay: starting a small replay for orbital only. Watching for 401s and duplicate-detection drift.

liam: replay results: 30 attempted -> 29 success, 1 failed due to email conflict. No 401s.

karen: Postmortem actions: - ensure IAM role rename and KMS grant recreate ordering in terraform (depend_on), - add a deploy canary that runs a decrypt-probe + idp token exchange after any secret/key change, - change provisioner error handling to map KMS AccessDenied/KeyNotFound to a retryable provisioning state (avoid dedupe 500 path), - plan a scheduled rewrap of long-lived secrets to new key material after rotation.

nijay: also flag for vulnerability triage: secrets unavailable mid-deploy is a critical vector. Add monitoring alert when KMS decrypt error rate > 0.5% over 5m.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-1650 created owner=nijay severity=medium teams=eng-security,infra,devex

liam: I'll follow up with an IaC patch to add explicit ordering and a small PR to provisioner to classify KMS errors.

karen: I'll draft the incident doc and include the terraform diff and grant ids. Ping me if you need raw audit lines. :thumbsup:
